scope: Development experiment after prior test outcomes; no new test scoring or refit

model.processing: nine original SU(4) blocks, 15 original Gell-Mann generators each
model.queries: alternating U/U-dagger, controlled on processing |11>; same U(x) at every query
model.rotation: R_l=tensor_j Ry(pi*(a[5*l+j]-0.5)); qubit zero most significant
model.probe: sqrt(softmax([0,31 trainable real logits])); original paired product initialization

preprocessing: existing authenticated split, all row multiplicities, fit-only StandardScaler; a=0.5+atan(z)/pi; no PCA or feature selection

reporting.primary: paired validation ROC-AUC differences across all 15 starts
reporting.aggregation: mean three starts within resample; mean and sample SD over five overlapping resample means
reporting.target: One percentage-point quantum-baseline matching target is descriptive, not a noninferiority test
